tools.name: check_address
tools.description: Check a contract address on Robinhood Chain before buying, holding or accepting it: a token in Robinhood's list, a known look-alike, or unknown. Free, and about identity only: for a listed token's supply, multiplier and integrity flags, use get_token_summary. A look-alike answer names the token it i

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_address" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Same answer as GET https://pegproof.com/v" → after: "Check a contract address on Robinhood Chain before buying, holding or accepting it: a token in Robinhood's list, a known look-alike, or unknown. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
